placement_proposal.reason: REACHABLE EFFECT SINKS is empty, so only an explicit untrusted instruction carrying an extra entity, endpoint, or authorization into a later action would qualify. There is no embedded imperative, no instruction to copy a handle into a later action, and no positive control/selection/go-ahead conclusion that could be laundered into an authority-sensitive Effect. The named entities are ordinary facts the trusted assessment summarizes, not extra operations. No sound marker or basis probe exists.
